job.title: In Store Florist
job.description:
Our client, a market leader in wholesale floral and potted products, priding themselves on product quality and customer service are seeking to recruit Floral Wrappers/florists with previous experience or training to join our team on a casual basis 5-6 days per week.

We are looking for an enthusiastic individual to work within a retail space who will ensure the highest quality customer service, floral ranges and flower arrangements are provided for the store’s customers. Recent graduates of floristry training encouraged to apply.

Located in Brisbane CBD, duties will include:

  • Wrapping of mixed and single floral bunches (small and large)
  • Bouquet arrangements to customer specification
  • Use of specialised gift-wrapping materials
  • Advising customers on floral selections
  • Merchandising the store to showcase designs and quality
  • Maintaining stock levels
  • Maintaining a safe, clean, and well-organised working and shopping environment and comply with all applicable health and safety procedures and safe work practices.

To be successful, candidates will have the following:

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively unsupervised
  • Certificate 3 in Floristry or equivalent experience
  • Ability to follow instructions and procedures
  • Passion for floral retail
  • Creative flair
  • Effective time management skills
  • Strong work ethic
  • Ability to visually examine products for quality and freshness
  • Available to work shifts on Monday - Friday (potentially Saturdays), Start time approx. from 7:30am.
  • Expected hours roughly 30 hours/wk
  • Previous exposure to a retail environment would be advantageous

Applicants will be notified via email and phone if successful for interview selection. Please ensure your application has a current email address and mobile number.

job.title: Experienced Bar Staff & Duty Managers
job.description:
Summer at Adelaide Bowling Club is about to get busy, and we're looking for experienced Bar Staff and Duty Managers to join us for the season.
We're one of Adelaide CBD's best-known function and event venues, with a busy calendar of corporate functions, Christmas events and social bookings. We pride ourselves on fast, friendly service, high standards and creating a great atmosphere for our guests.
If you know your way around a busy bar, enjoy working as part of a strong team and thrive when the pace picks up, we'd love to hear from you.

Who we're after

Experienced hospitality people who take pride in what they do and still enjoy themselves on shift. You can read a room, move quickly, communicate well with your team and maintain high standards when things get busy.

What you'll bring

  • Current RSA
  • Solid bar experience in a high-volume venue. Experience is essential
  • Exceptional beer, wine and cocktail service
  • Tray service for functions and events
  • Bepoz POS experience highly regarded
  • The ability to multitask and think on your feet without losing your head or your smile
  • Availability across our peak summer period, including evenings and weekends.
  • Strong availability throughout November and December will be highly regarded
  • For Duty Managers: current South Australian Responsible Person approval, plus experience in floor leadership, staff direction, service standards and problem-solving during live events

What's on offer

  • Experience with a well-known Adelaide CBD venue with a busy calendar of functions and events
  • A capable team that works well together and supports each other on shift
  • Strong seasonal hours across a busy summer of functions and events
  • Good working conditions and a venue that backs its staff

Ready to go?

Hit apply with your CV and a short note covering where you've worked, what you're great at behind the bar and your availability across. Shortlisting starts immediately, so don't miss out!
